name: HC16: No. of HIV patients eligible for CPT/Dapsone during the reporting quarter
description: Counts unique HIV patients who had started ART, were active on ART during the reporting quarter, and were eligible for CPT/Dapsone based on CD4 ≤350 cells/mm³ or WHO clinical stage 3/4, including T3/T4 variants.
creator: 82f18b44-6814-11e8-923f-e9a88dcb533f

  "sqlTemplate": "SELECT DISTINCT a.patient_id
FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card a

        (a.encounter_date >= :startDate

        OR a.return_visit_date > :endDate
    )
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1

              AND r.art_start_date <= :endDate

            'PREGNANT',
            REPLACE(a.pregnancy_status, ', ', ',')

            SELECT 1
            FROM mamba_dim_person p

            'HIV WHO CLINICAL STAGE 3',

            'HIV WHO CLINICAL STAGE T3',
            'HIV WHO CLINICAL STAGE T4'
        )

sqlTemplate:
SELECT DISTINCT a.patient_id
FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card a
WHERE
    (
        (a.encounter_date >= :startDate
         AND a.encounter_date < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY))
        OR a.return_visit_date > :endDate
    )
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_summary s
        WHERE s.patient_id = a.patient_id
    )
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM mamba_fact_patients_latest_regimen r
        WHERE r.patient_id = a.patient_id
          AND r.art_start_date IS NOT NULL
          AND r.art_start_date <= :endDate
    )
    AND (
        EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM mamba_fact_patients_latest_regimen r
            WHERE r.patient_id = a.patient_id
              AND r.art_start_date IS NOT NULL
              AND r.art_start_date >= DATE_SUB(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 YEAR)
              AND r.art_start_date <= :endDate
        )

        OR FIND_IN_SET(
            'PREGNANT',
            REPLACE(a.pregnancy_status, ', ', ',')
        ) > 0

        OR FIND_IN_SET(
            'Breast feeding',
            REPLACE(a.pregnancy_status, ', ', ',')
        ) > 0

        OR EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM mamba_dim_person p
            WHERE p.person_id = a.patient_id
              AND p.age <= 15
        )

        OR a.who_hiv_clinical_stage IN (
            'HIV WHO CLINICAL STAGE 3',
            'HIV WHO CLINICAL STAGE 4',
            'HIV WHO CLINICAL STAGE T3',
            'HIV WHO CLINICAL STAGE T4'
        )
    );
